brief: The canvas displays a captivating, multi-component steampunk sculpture built around a rotating cube. Delicate splines of tarnished copper and deep emerald glass trace elliptical orbits around the central core. At the center, a sphere glows with the appearance of molten bronze, casting warmth onto the structure. The glass tracery is highly detailed, featuring visible internal glowing seams that simulate captured rainbow light, giving the entire, perpetually moving assembly a complex, ethereal luminosity.

statement: This sketch depicts a steampunk sculpture centered around a rotating cube, featuring intricate glass tracery and copper splines that trace elliptical orbits. The composition captures the ethereal luminosity of a perpetually moving assembly with glowing elements at its core. Using WEBGL rendering, it creates depth through layered geometric forms, with detailed internal seams in the glass components and animated copper splines that pulse gently in three-dimensional space. The visual effect combines warm bronze glows with cool emerald tones to evoke a sense of mechanical artistry and captured light within an otherwise dark environment.
